Regarding the effectiveness of the described physical therapy technique, Myofascial release therapy is generally considered effective for treating myofascial pain syndrome. By applying gentle, sustained pressure to the fascial connective tissues, it aims to relieve restrictions that cause pain and limit motion. This technique can help alleviate pain in sensitive muscle points and improve the range of motion, making it a valuable tool in managing conditions characterized by myofascial pain. However, its effectiveness can vary depending on the individual and the specific nature of the injury or condition being treated.
